item.tib: smon lam yongs su bkod pa'i mdo chen
item.coloph: de ltar smon lam nor bu yongs su bkod pa'i mdo chen zhes bya ba sho lo ka bcu drug gi rnam par nges pa 'di/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis brag sha ba'i mdun gyi lho phyogs su brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//

item.tib: smon lam yongs su bkod pa'i mdo chen
item.coloph: ces bkra shis brjod pa rnam par brtsegs (pa'i) lhun po zhes bya ba dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis byang gis (gi) sa gnas rdza gseb kyi bya 'grang rgya del zhes bya bar sa glang hor zla brgyad kyi nyin brtsams pa dge legs 'phel//
